'''David B. Goldstein''' was an American energy conservation policy expert.  
He co-directs the [[Natural Resources Defense Council]]'s Energy Program.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://savingenergygrowingjobs.com/segj-athr.html|title = David B. Goldstein}}</ref> He currently serves as the board chair of the [[Institute for Market Transformation]], which he co-founded in 1996<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imt.org/about/board|title=Board of Directors &#124; IMT|date=16 April 2018}}</ref> and as the board president of [[New Buildings Institute]], for which he is also a founding director.<ref>{{Cite web|title=David Goldstein|url=https://newbuildings.org/board-member/david-goldstein/|access-date=2021-08-11|website=New Buildings Institute|language=en-US}}</ref>

==Biography==
He graduated from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] with a Ph.D. in Physics.

==Awards==
* 2002 [[MacArthur Fellows Program]]
* Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]]
* [[Leo Szilard Lectureship Award|Leo Szilard Award]] for Physics in the Public Interest
* 2003 California Alumni Association’s Award for Excellence in Achievement
